card.text: Explore Caliban, a moon of Uranus, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Caliban is an outer moon of Uranus. Its light curve constrains a minimum elongation, while a tentative thermal measurement sets the adopted size. This is an illustrative ellipsoid with assumed depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate minimum-elongation ellipsoid from the K 2 light curve. The tentative thermal diameter is 42 (+20/−12)km. Equal short axes, volume normalization and orientation are assumed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
